description: Send the user's event request to matching providers on Gigstereo, for free: the providers who are interested contact the user directly by WhatsApp or email with their price. It is not a booking and costs nothing. Before calling: (1) collect the details from the user — never invent a name, phone or email; (2) show them a summary and tell them that Gigstereo will share their name and contact details with the matching providers, under the privacy policy https://gigstereo.com/privacy and the terms https://gigstereo.com/terms; (3) call only after they explicitly say yes, with userConsent=true. With targetProviderSlug the request goes to that provider; without it, to the providers of the city.

budget.description: The user's budget in their words, e.g. hasta 800.000 COP.

category.description: Service wanted (e.g. mariachi, DJ, fotógrafo) or a slug from list_categories. Required unless targetProviderSlug is given.

city.description: City of the event in Colombia.

details.description: What the user needs, 1-4 sentences (10-1500 characters). Spanish preferred: providers read it.

durationOrSongs.description: Duration or number of songs, e.g. 1 hora or 10 canciones.

email.description: The user's email. Phone or email is required.

eventDate.description: Event date, YYYY-MM-DD. Not in the past.

eventType.description: Kind of event: boda (wedding), quinceañera, cumpleaños (birthday), serenata, corporativo…

phone.description: The user's Colombian mobile/WhatsApp number (10 digits, e.g. 3001234567). Phone or email is required.

targetProviderSlug.description: Slug of the provider the user chose, if they chose one.

userConsent.description: true only if the user saw the summary and the data-sharing notice above and explicitly agreed to send it.

name: request_quotes
title: Request quotes for an event
